item.title: [英语] IELTS5 Reading Passage 1 - 2026-08-18 01:16
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：49 分钟 (2416 字符)

原文 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
There was no standard way of speaking or writing and no agreement as to the best way of bringing some order to the chaos of English spelling. 没有标准的说或写方式，也没有一致意见：用什么最佳方式给混乱的英语拼写带来一些秩序。 standard：标准的
agreement：一致意见
as to：关于
bring order to：给……带来秩序
chaos：混乱
spelling：拼写		 There was no... and no... 为并列否定结构；as to 后接名词或疑问词引导的从句，表示“关于”。
Dr Johnson provided the solution. 约翰逊博士提供了解决办法。 solution：解决办法 provide the solution 表示“提供解决办法”；solution 常与 to 搭配，如 the solution to the problem。
There had, of course, been dictionaries in the past, the first of these being a little book of some 120 pages, compiled by a certain Robert Cawdray, published in 1604 under the title 'A Table Alphabeticall of hard usuall English wordes'. 当然，过去曾有过一些词典，其中第一本是一本约120页的小书，由一位叫罗伯特·考德雷的人编纂，1604年以《难用的常用英语词汇字母表》为名出版。 of course：当然
compile：编纂
publish：出版
under the title：以……为标题
a certain：某个
some：大约
alphabeticall：字母顺序的（古拼写）
usuall：常用的（古拼写）
wordes：词汇（古拼写）		 the first of these being... 为独立主格结构，表示补充说明；compiled... / published... 为过去分词短语作后置定语。
Like the various dictionaries that came after it during the seventeenth century, Cawdray's tended to concentrate on 'scholarly' words; one function of the dictionary was to enable its student to convey an impression of fine learning. 与17世纪继它之后出现的各种词典一样，考德雷的词典倾向于集中收录“学术性”词汇；词典的功能之一是让使用者传达出博学的印象。 various：各种各样的
tend to：倾向于
concentrate on：集中于
scholarly：学术的
function：功能
enable sb to do：使某人能够做
convey：传达
impression：印象
fine learning：博学		 Like... 为介词短语作比较状语；that came after it 为定语从句修饰 dictionaries；one function of... was to enable... 中不定式作表语。
Beyond the practical need to make order out of chaos, the rise of dictionaries is associated with the rise of the English middle class, who were anxious to define and circumscribe the various worlds to conquer - lexical as well as social and commercial. 除了让混乱变得有序这一实际需要之外，词典的兴起也与英国中产阶级的兴起有关；他们急于界定并限制各个即将征服的领域——词汇领域以及社会和商业领域。 beyond：除……之外
practical：实际的
make order out of chaos：从混乱中建立秩序
be associated with：与……有关
middle class：中产阶级
anxious：急于的
define：界定
circumscribe：限制、划定
conquer：征服
lexical：词汇的
commercial：商业的		 Beyond... 作状语，表示“除……之外”；who were anxious to... 为非限制性定语从句修饰 middle class；as well as 连接并列成分。
It is highly appropriate that Dr Samuel Johnson, the very model of an eighteenth-century literary man, as famous in his own time as in ours, should have published his Dictionary at the very beginning of the heyday of the middle class. 塞缪尔·约翰逊博士是18世纪文人的典范，他在自己的时代和在我们的时代同样有名；他在中产阶级全盛期之初出版词典，这是非常恰当的。 highly：非常
appropriate：恰当的
model：典范
literary：文学的
as famous... as...：和……一样有名
publish：出版
at the very beginning of：在……最初
heyday：全盛时期		 It is highly appropriate that... 为主语从句；should have published 在此表示“竟然/应当”；the very model of... 作 Dr Samuel Johnson 的同位语。
Johnson was a poet and critic who raised common sense to the heights of genius. 约翰逊是一位诗人和评论家，他把常识提升到了天才的高度。 poet：诗人
critic：评论家
common sense：常识
raise... to...：把……提升到……
heights：高度、巅峰
genius：天才		 who raised... 为定语从句修饰 a poet and critic；raise... to the heights of... 是比喻性表达。
His approach to the problems that had worried writers throughout the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries was intensely practical. 他处理那些困扰了17世纪末和18世纪初作家们的问题的方法非常务实。 approach：方法
worry：使担忧
throughout：贯穿
intensely：极度地
practical：务实的		 approach to the problems 中的 to 是介词，后接名词；that had worried... 为定语从句修饰 problems。
Up until his time, the task of producing a dictionary on such a large scale had seemed impossible without the establishment of an academy to make decisions about right and wrong usage. 在他那个时代之前，若不建立一个负责判定用法正误的学院，如此大规模地编写词典的任务似乎是不可能完成的。 up until：直到……之前
task：任务
on such a large scale：如此大规模地
establishment：建立
academy：学院、学会
make decisions about：对……作出决定
usage：用法		 Up until his time 为时间状语；without the establishment of... 为介词短语，表示假设条件；to make decisions 为不定式作后置定语修饰 academy。
Johnson decided he did not need an academy to settle arguments about language; he would write a dictionary himself; and he would do it single-handed. 约翰逊认定他不需要一个学院来解决关于语言的争论；他要自己编写一本词典，并且要独自完成。 decide：决定
settle：解决
argument：争论
single-handed：独自地		 decided 后接省略 that 的宾语从句；did not need... to settle... 中不定式作目的或补充；he would... 表示过去的决心或意图；single-handed 作方式状语。
Johnson signed the contract for the Dictionary with the bookseller Robert Dosley at a breakfast held at the Golden Anchor Inn near Holborn Bar on 18 June 1764. 1764年6月18日，在霍尔本栅栏附近的金锚旅馆举行的一次早餐上，约翰逊与书商罗伯特·多斯利签订了这部词典的合同。 sign：签署
contract：合同
bookseller：书商
inn：小旅馆
bar：栅栏（此处为地名）
held：举行		 signed the contract with sb 表示“与某人签合同”；at a breakfast held at... 中 held 为过去分词作后置定语修饰 breakfast。
He was to be paid £1,575 in instalments, and from this he took money to rent 17 Gough Square, in which he set up his 'dictionary workshop'. 他将以分期付款的方式获得1575英镑，并从中拿出钱租下高夫广场17号，在那里建立了他的“词典工作坊”。 be to do：计划/注定要做
instalments：分期付款
rent：租用
set up：建立
workshop：工作坊		 was to be paid 为过去将来时被动式；in instalments 表示“以分期付款方式”；in which he set up... 为非限制性定语从句修饰 17 Gough Square。
James Boswell, his biographer, described the garret where Johnson worked as 'fitted up like a counting house' with a long desk running down the middle at which the copying clerks would work standing up. 他的传记作者詹姆斯·博斯韦尔描述约翰逊工作的阁楼“布置得像一间账房”，中间放着一张长桌，抄写员们会站在桌边工作。 biographer：传记作者
describe... as...：把……描述为……
garret：阁楼
fitted up：布置
counting house：账房
running down the middle：沿中间延伸
clerk：文书、职员
standing up：站着		 his biographer 为 James Boswell 的同位语；where Johnson worked 为定语从句修饰 garret；with a long desk running... 为 with 复合结构；at which... 为定语从句修饰 desk。
Johnson himself was stationed on a rickety chair at an old crazy deal table surrounded by a chaos of borrowed books. 约翰逊本人坐在一张摇摇晃晃的椅子上，面对一张破旧的松木桌，四周堆满了借来的书。 station：安置、使就座
rickety：摇摇晃晃的
crazy：破旧的、歪斜的
deal table：松木桌
surrounded by：被……包围
chaos：混乱
borrowed：借来的		 was stationed 为被动语态，表示“被安置在”；surrounded by... 为过去分词短语作后置定语；a chaos of 表示“大量杂乱的”。
He was also helped by six assistants, two of whom died whilst the Dictionary was still in preparation. 他还得到六名助手的帮助，其中两人在词典仍在编纂期间去世。 assistant：助手
whilst：当……时候
in preparation：在准备中		 was helped by 为被动语态；two of whom died 为非限制性定语从句，whom 指代 six assistants；whilst 相当于 while。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 3 等多主题 - 2026-08-17 01:19
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：33 分钟 (1607 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
We have found that the blind understand other kinds of visual metaphors as well. 我们发现盲人也能理解其他类型的视觉隐喻。 visual metaphors：视觉隐喻
as well：也		 that引导宾语从句；as well 放句末表示“也”。
One blind woman drew a picture of a child inside a heart - choosing that symbol, she said, to show that love surrounded the child. 一位失明女性画了一幅孩子在心形里面的画——她选择那个符号，她说，是为了表明爱包围着这个孩子。 drew a picture：画了一幅画
symbol：符号
surrounded：包围		 破折号后为现在分词短语作伴随状语；she said是插入语；to show...为目的状语。
With Chang Hong Liu, a doctoral student from China, I have begun exploring how well blind people understand the symbolism behind shapes such as hearts that do not directly represent their meaning. 和来自中国的博士生 Chang Hong Liu 一起，我已经开始探索盲人在多大程度上理解像心形这样并不直接代表其含义的形状背后的象征意义。 doctoral student：博士生
exploring：探索
symbolism：象征意义
represent：代表		 With...介词短语作状语；a doctoral student from China是同位语；how well引导宾语从句；such as hearts that...中that引导定语从句修饰hearts。
We gave a list of twenty pairs of words to sighted subjects and asked them to pick from each pair the term that best related to a circle and the term that best related to a square. 我们给视力正常的受试者一份二十对词的列表，并要求他们从每一对中选出与圆形最相关的词和与方形最相关的词。 sighted subjects：视力正常的受试者
term：词语；术语
related to：与……相关		 gave和asked并列作谓语；asked them to pick...为不定式宾补；that best related...为定语从句修饰term。
For example, we asked: What goes with soft? A circle or a square? Which shape goes with hard? 例如，我们问：什么与柔软相配？圆形还是方形？哪个形状与坚硬相配？ goes with：与……相配
soft：柔软的
hard：坚硬的		 直接引语；What goes with soft? 疑问句结构：What + goes with + 名词。
All our subjects deemed the circle soft and the square hard. 我们所有的受试者都认为圆形柔软、方形坚硬。 deemed：认为
soft：柔软的
hard：坚硬的		 deem + 宾语 + 形容词，表示“认为……”。
A full 94% ascribed happy to the circle, instead of sad. 整整94%的人把快乐归于圆形，而不是悲伤。 ascribed：把……归于
instead of：而不是		 ascribe A to B 把A归于B；instead of 后接形容词/名词。
But other pairs revealed less agreement: 79% matched fast to slow and weak to strong, respectively. 但其他配对显示出较少的共识：79%的人分别将快与慢、弱与强进行匹配。 revealed：显示出
agreement：一致
respectively：分别地		 冒号引出具体数据；respectively 分别地，注意对应顺序。
And only 51% linked deep to circle and shallow to square. (See Fig. 2) 只有51%的人把深与圆形、浅与方形联系起来。（见图2） linked：联系
shallow：浅的		 link A to B 把A和B联系起来；See Fig. 2 为插入语。
When we tested four totally blind volunteers using the same list, we found that their choices closely resembled those made by the sighted subjects. 当我们用同样的列表测试四名完全失明的志愿者时，我们发现他们的选择与视力正常的受试者做出的选择非常相似。 totally：完全地
volunteers：志愿者
closely resembled：非常相似		 When引导时间状语从句；that引导宾语从句；those made by...过去分词短语作后置定语，意思是“由……做出的选择”。
One man, who had been blind since birth, scored extremely well. 一名从出生起就失明的男子表现得极好。 blind since birth：先天失明
scored extremely well：表现得极好		 who引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明；since birth 从出生起。
He made only one match differing from the consensus, assigning 'far' to square and 'near' to circle. 他只有一处匹配与共识不同，把“far”对应到方形，把“near”对应到圆形。 consensus：共识
assigning：分配；归因
differing from：与……不同		 differing from...现在分词短语作定语；assigning...现在分词短语作伴随状语。
In fact, only a small majority of sighted subjects - 53% - had paired far and near to the opposite partners. 事实上，只有微弱多数的视力正常受试者——53%——将 far 和 near 与共识中相反的伙伴配对。 majority：多数
opposite partners：相反的配对		 破折号插入53%；only a small majority 微弱多数；pair A to B 把A与B配对。
Thus, we concluded that the blind interpret abstract shapes as sighted people do. 因此，我们得出结论：盲人和视力正常的人一样理解抽象形状。 concluded：得出结论
interpret：理解
abstract shapes：抽象形状		 conclude that... 得出结论；as sighted people do 为方式状语从句，do替代interpret。
For the century before Johnson's Dictionary was published in 1775, there had been concern about the state of the English language. 在1775年《约翰逊词典》出版之前的那个世纪里，人们一直对英语语言的状况感到担忧。 concern：担忧
state：状况
published：出版		 For the century before...时间状语；before Johnson's Dictionary was published为时间状语从句；there had been concern 过去完成时表示持续到过去某时的担忧。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 3 - 2026-08-14 02:01
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：39 分钟 (1912 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
Majority rule would argue that this device somehow indicated motion very well.多数原则会认为这个装置以某种方式很好地指示了运动。majority rule：多数原则
device：装置，设备
indicate：指示，表明
motion：运动		would argue 表示“会主张/认为”，是常见的拟人表达；somehow 表示“以某种方式，不知怎么地”。
But was it a better indicator than, say, broken or wavy lines – or any other kind of line, for that matter?但它就是比，比如说，断裂的线或波浪线——或任何其他种类的线——更好的指示物吗？indicator：指示物，指标
wavy：波浪形的
broken line：断裂的线，虚线
for that matter：就此而言，而且		than, say, ... 中的 say 是插入语，表示举例“比如说”；for that matter 用于补充说明“就此而言”。
The answer was not clear.答案并不明确。clear：清楚的，明确的
not clear：不清楚		not clear 是常见的形容词作表语的否定表达。
So I decided to test whether various lines of motion were apt ways of showing movement or if they were merely idiosyncratic marks.因此我决定测试各种运动线条是否是表示运动的合适方式，或者它们是否仅仅是特殊的记号。apt：合适的，恰当的
merely：仅仅，只不过
idiosyncratic：独特的，怪异的
marks：记号，痕迹		whether ... or if ... 引导并列的宾语从句，表示“是……还是……”；apt ways 中 apt 表示“合适的”。
Moreover, I wanted to discover whether there were differences in how the blind and the sighted interpreted lines of motion.此外，我想发现盲人和视力正常者在理解运动线条方面是否存在差异。Moreover：此外，而且
discover：发现
the blind / the sighted：盲人 / 视力正常者
interpret：解释，理解		the + 形容词表示一类人，如 the blind, the sighted；how 引导的宾语从句作 in 的宾语。
To search out these answers, I created raised-line drawings of five different wheels, depicting spokes with lines that curved, bent, waved, dashed and extended beyond the perimeter of the wheel.为了找出这些答案，我制作了五个不同轮子的凸起线条图，图中用弯曲、折弯、波浪、虚线和延伸到轮子周边之外的线条来描绘辐条。search out：找出，查明
raised-line drawings：凸起线条图
depict：描绘
spokes：辐条
curved：弯曲的
bent：折弯的
dashed：虚线的
perimeter：周界，周长		To search out... 不定式表目的；depicting... 现在分词短语作伴随/后置定语；lines that curved, bent, waved, dashed and extended... 中几个过去式并列作定语从句谓语。
I then asked eighteen blind volunteers to feel the wheels and assign one of the following motions to each wheel: wobbling, spinning fast, spinning steadily, jerking or braking.然后我请十八位盲人志愿者触摸这些轮子，并给每个轮子分配以下动作之一：摆动、快速旋转、匀速旋转、急动或刹车。volunteers：志愿者
assign：分配，指派
wobbling：摇摆，晃动
spinning：旋转
steadily：稳定地，持续地
jerking：急动，颠簸
braking：刹车		ask sb to do sth 结构；assign A to B：将A分配给B；冒号后列举动作，用动名词形式。
My control group consisted of eighteen sighted undergraduates from the University of Toronto.我的对照组由十八名来自多伦多大学的视力正常本科生组成。control group：对照组
consist of：由……组成
undergraduates：本科生		consist of 表示“由……组成”，不用于被动语态；from the University of Toronto 作后置定语。
All but one of the blind subjects assigned distinctive motions to each wheel.除了一名盲人受试者外，所有盲人都给每个轮子分配了不同的动作。All but one：除一个以外的所有
subjects：受试者，实验对象
distinctive：独特的，有区别的		All but one 表示“除一个之外的全部”；assign sth to sb/sth 结构再次出现。
Most guessed that the curved spokes indicated that the wheel was spinning steadily; the wavy spokes, they thought, suggested that the wheel was wobbling; and the bent spokes were taken as a sign that the wheel was jerking.大多数人猜测弯曲的辐条表示轮子在匀速旋转；他们认为波浪形辐条表明轮子在摆动；而折弯的辐条被看作是轮子在急动的标志。guessed：猜测
curved：弯曲的
spinning steadily：匀速旋转
wavy：波浪形的
suggested：暗示，表明
bent：折弯的
taken as a sign：被当作标志		guessed that... 宾语从句；they thought 作插入语；be taken as 表示“被当作/认为”。
Subjects assumed that spokes extending beyond the wheel's perimeter signified that the wheel had its brakes on and that dashed spokes indicated the wheel was spinning quickly.受试者认为，延伸到轮子周边之外的辐条意味着轮子正在刹车，而虚线辐条表明轮子转得很快。assumed：假定，认为
extending beyond：延伸超出
perimeter：周界，周长
signified：表示，意味着
brakes on：刹车（状态）
dashed：虚线的
spinning quickly：快速旋转		extending beyond... 现在分词短语作后置定语；signified that... 宾语从句；had its brakes on 中 on 表示处于开启/使用状态。
In addition, the favored description for the sighted was the favored description for the blind in every instance.此外，在每个实例中，视力正常者偏好的描述也正是盲人偏好的描述。In addition：此外
favored：受青睐的，偏好的
description：描述
in every instance：在每一个事例中		In addition 用于补充；favored description 指“最受偏好的描述”；in every instance 作状语。
What is more, the consensus among the sighted was barely higher than that among the blind.更重要的是，视力正常者之间的共识度仅比盲人之间的共识度略高一点。What is more：更重要的是
consensus：共识，一致意见
barely：仅仅，几乎不
among：在……之中		What is more 是递进连接语；barely higher than 表示“仅略高于”；that 指代前面的 consensus，避免重复。
Because motion devices are unfamiliar to the blind, the task I gave them involved some problem solving.由于运动装置对盲人来说并不熟悉，我交给他们的任务涉及了一些问题解决过程。motion devices：运动装置
unfamiliar：不熟悉的
involved：涉及，需要
problem solving：问题解决		Because 引导原因状语从句；unfamiliar to sb 表示“对某人来说不熟悉”；I gave them 是省略了关系代词 that/which 的定语从句修饰 task。
Evidently, however, the blind not only figured out meanings for each line of motion, but as a group they generally came up with the same meaning at least as frequently as did sighted subjects.然而，很明显，盲人不仅弄清了每种运动线条的含义，而且作为一个群体，他们通常得出相同含义的频率至少与视力正常受试者一样高。Evidently：显然，明显地
figured out：弄明白，理解
as a group：作为一个群体
came up with：提出，想出
at least as frequently as：至少和……一样频繁		not only... but... 连接并列谓语/句子；as frequently as did sighted subjects 是倒装比较状语从句，did 代替 came up with；figure out 和 come up with 为短语动词。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 2 等多主题 - 2026-08-11 01:48
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：42 分钟 (2075 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
Although the senses of taste and smell appear to have deteriorated, and vision in water appears to be uncertain, such weaknesses are more than compensated for by cetaceans' well-developed acoustic sense.尽管味觉和嗅觉似乎已经退化，水中视力也显得不可靠，但这些弱点被鲸类发达的听觉所弥补，而且还绰绰有余。deteriorated：退化
compensated for：弥补，补偿
cetaceans：鲸类动物
acoustic：听觉的		Although 引导让步状语从句；more than compensated for 中 more than 加强程度，表示“远远不只是弥补”。
Most species are highly vocal, although they vary in the range of sounds they produce, and many forage for food using echolocation.大多数物种都很善于发声，尽管它们发出的声音范围各不相同，而且许多物种利用回声定位来觅食。vocal：发声的，有声音的
vary in：在…方面不同
forage for：搜寻（食物）
echolocation：回声定位		although 连接让步状语从句；using echolocation 为现在分词短语作方式状语。
Large baleen whales primarily use the lower frequencies and are often limited in their repertoire.大型须鲸主要使用较低频率，其声音节目通常也很有限。baleen whales：须鲸
primarily：主要地
frequencies：频率
repertoire：全部节目，这里指能发出的全部声音		are limited in their repertoire 表示“在声音种类上有限”。
Notable exceptions are the nearly song-like choruses of bowhead whales in summer and the complex, haunting utterances of the humpback whales.值得注意的例外是夏季弓头鲸近乎歌曲般的合唱，以及座头鲸复杂而令人难忘的叫声。notable：显著的，值得注意的
choruses：合唱
bowhead whales：弓头鲸
haunting：萦绕心头的，令人难忘的
utterances：发声，叫声
humpback whales：座头鲸		notable exceptions 为主语，are 后面跟两个并列的表语，介绍两种例外情况。
Toothed species in general employ more of the frequency spectrum, and produce a wider variety of sounds, than baleen species (though the sperm whale apparently produces a monotonous series of high-energy clicks and little else).齿鲸类总体上比须鲸类使用更宽的频谱，并产生更多样的声音（尽管抹香鲸显然只发出单调的一系列高能咔嗒声，其余几乎没有）。toothed species：齿鲸类
employ：使用，利用
frequency spectrum：频谱
baleen species：须鲸类
sperm whale：抹香鲸
monotonous：单调的
clicks：咔嗒声		比较级 more... than...；括号内 though 引导让步状语从句；a monotonous series of... 表示“一连串单调的…”。
Some of the more complicated sounds are clearly communicative, although what role they may play in the social life and 'culture' of cetaceans has been more the subject of wild speculation than of solid science.一些较复杂的声音明显具有交流功能，尽管它们在鲸类的社会生活和“文化”中可能起什么作用，与其说是可靠的科学，不如说是胡乱的猜测。complicated：复杂的
communicative：交流的，交际的
role：作用，角色
wild speculation：胡乱的猜测
solid science：可靠的科学结论		what role they may play 为主语从句；more A than B 结构表示“与其说是B，不如说是A”。
From a number of recent studies, it has become clear that blind people can appreciate the use of outlines and perspectives to describe the arrangement of objects and other surfaces in space.根据大量近期研究，盲人能够理解用轮廓和透视法来描述物体和其他表面在空间中的排列这一点，已经变得很清楚。appreciate：理解，领会
outlines：轮廓
perspectives：透视法，视角
arrangement：排列，安排
surfaces：表面		it has become clear that... 为形式主语句式；that 从句为主语。
But pictures are more than literal representations.但图画不仅仅是照字面的再现。literal representations：字面再现，写实表现
more than：不仅仅是		more than 表达“不只是”的含义。
This fact was drawn to my attention dramatically when a blind woman in one of my investigations decided on her own initiative to draw a wheel as it was spinning.当我在一项调查中的一位盲人女性主动决定画一个正在旋转的轮子时，这一事实戏剧性地引起了我的注意。drawn to one's attention：引起某人的注意
dramatically：戏剧性地，显著地
investigations：调查，研究
on one's own initiative：主动地
spinning：旋转的		be drawn to one's attention 为 draw sth to one's attention 的被动语态；decide to do... on one's own initiative 表示“主动决定做…”；as it was spinning 为时间状语从句。
To show this motion, she traced a curve inside the circle (Fig. 1).为了表现这种运动，她在圆圈内画了一条曲线（图1）。motion：运动
traced：勾勒，描画
curve：曲线		To show this motion 为不定式短语作目的状语。
I was taken aback.我大吃一惊。taken aback：吃惊，惊讶be taken aback 为固定搭配，表示“感到吃惊”。
Lines of motion, such as the one she used, are a very recent invention in the history of illustration.像她所用的那种运动线条，在插图史上是一项很晚近的发明。lines of motion：运动线条
recent invention：近期的发明
illustration：插图，图示		such as the one she used 为插入语，举例说明；are a very recent invention 为主系表结构。
Indeed, as art scholar David Kunzle notes, Wilhelm Busch, a trend-setting nineteenth-century cartoonist, used virtually no motion lines in his popular figures until about 1877.事实上，正如艺术学者戴维·孔兹勒所指出的，19世纪引领潮流的漫画家威廉·布施，直到大约1877年才在他流行的画作中几乎没有使用运动线条。scholar：学者
trend-setting：引领潮流的
cartoonist：漫画家
virtually：几乎
motion lines：运动线条
figures：人物，人像		as ... notes 为非限制性定语从句；a trend-setting ... cartoonist 为 Wilhelm Busch 的同位语；used virtually no ... until ... 结构表示“直到…才几乎没有使用”，即此前几乎不用。
When I asked several other blind study subjects to draw a spinning wheel, one particularly clever rendition appeared repeatedly: several subjects showed the wheel's spokes as curved lines.当我请其他几位盲人研究对象画一个旋转的轮子时，一种特别巧妙的画法反复出现：好几位对象把轮辐画成了曲线。study subjects：研究对象
spinning wheel：旋转的轮子
rendition：表现，画法
repeatedly：反复地
spokes：轮辐
curved lines：曲线		When 引导时间状语从句；冒号后对 clever rendition 进行解释；showed ... as ... 表示“把…显示为…”。
When asked about these curves, they all described them as metaphorical ways of suggesting motion.当被问及这些曲线时，他们都将其描述为暗示运动的隐喻方式。curves：曲线
described ... as：把…描述为
metaphorical：隐喻的
suggesting：暗示，表明		When asked... 为过去分词短语作时间状语，相当于 When they were asked...；describe ... as ... 为固定搭配；metaphorical ways of suggesting motion 表示“用隐喻的方式暗示运动”。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 2 - 2026-08-10 01:53
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：49 分钟 (2420 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
The sense of touch has sometimes been described as weak too, but this view is probably mistaken. 触觉有时也被描述为很弱，但这种看法很可能是错误的。 touch: 触觉
described as: 被描述为
view: 观点，看法
mistaken: 错误的		 “has been described as” 是现在完成时被动语态，表示“一直被描述为”；“this view is probably mistaken” 中 mistaken 是形容词作表语，表示“错误的”。注意转折连词 but。
Trainers of captive dolphins and small whales often remark on their animals' responsiveness to being touched or rubbed, and both captive and freeranging cetacean individuals of all species (particularly adults and calves, or members of the same subgroup) appear to make frequent contact. 圈养海豚和小鲸鱼的训练师经常谈及它们的动物对被触摸或揉搓的反应性，而且所有物种的圈养和自由放养的鲸目动物个体（特别是成年和幼崽，或者同一亚群的成员）似乎会频繁接触。 captive: 圈养的
remark on: 谈及，评论
responsiveness: 反应性
touched or rubbed: 被触摸或揉搓
freeranging: 自由放养的
cetacean: 鲸目动物
calves: 幼崽
subgroup: 亚群
make contact: 进行接触		 “remark on” 为固定搭配，表示“评论/谈及”；“responsiveness to being touched” 中 to 是介词，后接动名词被动式 being touched； “both captive and freeranging” 并列作定语修饰 cetacean individuals； “appear to make contact” 表示“似乎进行接触”。
This contact may help to maintain order within a group, and stroking or touching are part of the courtship ritual in most species. 这种接触可能有助于维持群体内的秩序，而抚摸或触碰在大多数物种中是求偶仪式的一部分。 maintain: 维持
order: 秩序
stroking: 抚摸
courtship: 求偶
ritual: 仪式		 “help to maintain” 中 help 后可接带 to 或不带 to 的不定式； “be part of” 意为“是……的一部分”； “courtship ritual” 为固定搭配“求偶仪式”。
The area around the blowhole is also particularly sensitive and captive animals often object strongly to being touched there. 喷气孔周围的区域也特别敏感，圈养动物常常强烈反对被触摸那里。 blowhole: 喷气孔
sensitive: 敏感的
object to: 反对		 “object to” 中 to 为介词，后接动名词被动式 being touched； “particularly sensitive” 作表语，表示“尤其敏感”。
The sense of vision is developed to different degrees in different species. 视觉在不同物种中发展到了不同的程度。 vision: 视觉
degree: 程度		 “is developed to different degrees” 被动语态，表示“被发展到不同程度”，强调客观描述。
Baleen species studied at close quarters underwater - specifically a grey whale calf in captivity for a year, and free-ranging right whales and humpback whales studied and filmed off Argentina and Hawaii - have obviously tracked objects with vision underwater, and they can apparently see moderately well both in water and in air. 在水下近距离研究的须鲸物种——具体来说，一只被圈养了一年的灰鲸幼崽，以及在阿根廷和夏威夷附近研究并拍摄的自由放养的露脊鲸和座头鲸——显然在水下用视觉追踪物体，而且它们显然在水中和空气中都有中等的视力。 baleen: 鲸须
at close quarters: 近距离地
grey whale: 灰鲸
right whale: 露脊鲸
humpback whale: 座头鲸
tracked: 追踪
moderately: 中等地		 “studied at close quarters” 是过去分词短语作定语；破折号之间是具体举例； “have tracked” 为现在完成时； “see moderately well” 表示视力中等； “both in water and in air” 并列状语。
However, the position of the eyes so restricts the field of vision in baleen whales that they probably do not have stereoscopic vision. 然而，眼睛的位置如此限制须鲸的视野，以至于它们可能没有立体视觉。 restricts: 限制
field of vision: 视野
stereoscopic: 立体的		 “so... that...” 句型表示“如此……以至于……”； “restrict the field of vision” 搭配； “stereoscopic vision” 意为“立体视觉”。
On the other hand, the position of the eyes in most dolphins and porpoises suggests that they have stereoscopic vision forward and downward. 另一方面，大多数海豚和鼠海豚的眼睛位置表明它们有向前和向下的立体视觉。 porpoises: 鼠海豚
stereoscopic: 立体的
forward and downward: 向前和向下		 “On the other hand” 表示对比； “suggests that” 后接宾语从句； “forward and downward” 作后置定语修饰 vision。
Eye position in freshwater dolphins, which often swim on their side or upside down while feeding, suggests that what vision they have is stereoscopic forward and upward. 淡水海豚的眼睛位置——它们经常在进食时侧着身子或倒置游泳——表明它们所具有的视觉是向前和向上的立体视觉。 freshwater: 淡水
upside down: 颠倒
feeding: 进食		 “which often swim...” 是非限制性定语从句； “what vision they have” 是主语从句，相当于 the vision that they have； “on their side or upside down” 方式状语。
By comparison, the bottlenose dolphin has extremely keen vision in water. 相比之下，宽吻海豚在水中有极其敏锐的视觉。 bottlenose dolphin: 宽吻海豚
keen: 敏锐的		 “By comparison” 意为“相比之下”； “extremely keen vision” 表示“极其敏锐的视觉”。
Judging from the way it watches and tracks airborne flying fish, it can apparently see fairly well through the air-water interface as well. 从它观察和追踪空中飞鱼的方式来看，它显然也能透过空气-水的界面看得相当清楚。 judging from: 从……判断
airborne: 空中的
flying fish: 飞鱼
interface: 界面		 “Judging from...” 是垂悬分词作状语； “the way it watches” 方式状语从句； “see fairly well through the air-water interface” 动介搭配。
And although preliminary experimental evidence suggests that their in-air vision is poor, the accuracy with which dolphins leap high to take small fish out of a trainer's hand provides anecdotal evidence to the contrary. 而且，尽管初步的实验证据表明它们的空中视觉很差，但海豚高高跳起从训练员手中取走小鱼的准确性提供了相反的轶事证据。 preliminary: 初步的
experimental: 实验的
accuracy: 准确性
leap: 跳跃
anecdotal: 轶事的
to the contrary: 相反地		 “although” 引导让步状语从句； “the accuracy with which dolphins leap...” 是“介词+关系代词”引导的定语从句，先行词 accuracy； “provides anecdotal evidence to the contrary” 提供了相反的非正式证据。
Such variation can no doubt be explained with reference to the habitats in which individual species have developed. 这种差异无疑可以通过各个物种发展所处的栖息地来解释。 variation: 差异
no doubt: 无疑
with reference to: 根据，参考
habitats: 栖息地		 “can no doubt be explained” 被动语态； “with reference to” 意为“根据，参考”； “in which individual species have developed” 定语从句修饰 habitats。
For example, vision is obviously more useful to species inhabiting clear open waters than to those living in turbid rivers and flooded plains. 例如，视觉对于栖息在清澈开阔水域的物种显然比对于生活在浑浊河流和泛滥平原的物种更有用。 inhabiting: 栖息于
turbid: 浑浊的
flooded plains: 泛滥平原		 “more useful to... than to...” 比较结构； “species inhabiting...” 现在分词作定语； “those living in...” 中 those 指代 species。
The South American boutu and Chinese beiji, for instance, appear to have very limited vision, and the Indian susus are blind, their eyes reduced to slits that probably allow them to sense only the direction and intensity of light. 例如，南美洲的亚马逊河豚和中国的白鳍豚似乎视力非常有限，而印度河豚是盲的，它们的眼睛退化为狭缝，可能只能感知光的方向和强度。 boutu: 亚马逊河豚
beiji: 白鳍豚
susus: 印度河豚
blind: 盲的
slits: 狭缝
intensity: 强度		 “appear to have” 似乎有； “their eyes reduced to slits” 是独立主格结构，表示伴随状态； “that probably allow...” 定语从句修饰 slits； “sense the direction and intensity” 感知方向和强度。

item.title: Unit 56-58
item.description: 【非谓语动词 60%】remember/regret（ing vs to do）；try/need/help；like/would like（ing vs to do）

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 1 等多主题 - 2026-08-07 02:43
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：44 分钟 (2170 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
In answer to the final question about the importance of rainforest conservation, the majority of children simply said that we need rainforests to survive.在回答关于雨林保护重要性的最后一个问题时，大多数孩子仅表示我们需要雨林才能生存。in answer to：作为对……的回答
conservation：保护
the majority of：大多数
simply：仅仅，简单地
survive：生存		“in answer to” 为固定短语，表示“作为对……的回答”；“the majority of + 复数名词” 作主语时，谓语可用单数或复数，此句用复数 said；“simply” 强调只说了一件事。
Only a few of the pupils (6%) mentioned that rainforest destruction may contribute to global warming.只有少数学生（6%）提到雨林破坏可能会导致全球变暖。a few of：几个，少数
pupils：学生
mentioned：提到
destruction：破坏
contribute to：促成，导致
global warming：全球变暖		“Only a few of...” 表示数量很少；“contribute to” 意为“促成，是……的原因之一”，后接名词或动名词。
This is surprising considering the high level of media coverage on this issue.考虑到媒体对这个问题的报道程度很高，这是令人惊讶的。surprising：令人惊讶的
considering：考虑到……
high level of：高水平的，大量的
media coverage：媒体报道
issue：问题		“considering” 是介词或连词，意为“考虑到”，引导原因状语；“media coverage” 不可数，指媒体覆盖。
Some children expressed the idea that the conservation of rainforests is not important.一些孩子表达了保护雨林并不重要的观点。expressed：表达
the idea that...：……的观点
conservation：保护
not important：不重要		“expressed the idea that...” 后接同位语从句，解释 idea 的内容；注意 conservation 不可数。
The results of this study suggest that certain ideas predominate in the thinking of children about rainforests.这项研究的结果表明，某些观念在孩子们关于雨林的想法中占主导地位。results：结果
suggest：表明
certain：某些
predominate：占优势，占主导地位
thinking：思维，想法		“suggest” 此处不是“建议”，而是“表明”，后接宾语从句无需用虚拟语气。“predominate in” 意为“在……中占主导”。
Pupils' responses indicate some misconceptions in basic scientific knowledge of rainforests' ecosystems such as their ideas about rainforests as habitats for animals, plants and humans and the relationship between climatic change and destruction of rainforests.学生的回答表明，他们在雨林生态系统的基本科学知识上存在一些误解，比如他们认为雨林是动物、植物和人类的栖息地，以及气候变化与雨林破坏之间的关系等看法。responses：回答
indicate：表明
misconceptions：误解
scientific knowledge：科学知识
ecosystems：生态系统
habitats：栖息地
climatic change：气候变化
destruction：破坏		“such as” 列举例子；句子较长，注意 “their ideas about... and the relationship...” 并列。“indicate” 后接宾语从句。
Pupils did not volunteer ideas that suggested that they appreciated the complexity of causes of rainforest destruction.学生们没有主动提出能表明他们认识到雨林破坏原因复杂性的观点。volunteer：自愿提供，主动说出
suggested：表明
appreciated：理解，认识到
complexity：复杂性
causes：原因
destruction：破坏		“volunteer” 用作动词，表示主动提供信息；“that suggested that...” 定语从句修饰 ideas，第二个 that 引导宾语从句；“appreciate” 在此意为“理解，意识到”，而非“欣赏”。
In other words, they gave no indication of an appreciation of either the range of ways in which rainforests are important or the complex social, economic and political factors which drive the activities which are destroying the rainforests.换句话说，他们丝毫没有表现出对雨林重要性的诸多方面，或驱动破坏雨林活动的复杂社会、经济和政治因素有所认识。in other words：换句话说
gave no indication of：没有表现出……的迹象
appreciation：理解，认识
range of：一系列
complex：复杂的
social, economic and political factors：社会、经济和政治因素
drive：驱动
activities：活动
destroying：破坏		“gave no indication of an appreciation of...” 双重名词结构，表示未表现出理解；“either...or...” 连接两个并列的 of 宾语；“range of ways in which...” 定语从句；“factors which drive the activities which are destroying...” 多重定语从句。
One encouragement is that the results of similar studies about other environmental issues suggest that older children seem to acquire the ability to appreciate, value and evaluate conflicting views.一个令人鼓舞的事实是，针对其他环境议题的类似研究结果表明，年龄较大的孩子似乎能够获得理解、重视和评估相互矛盾观点的能力。encouragement：令人鼓舞的事
similar studies：类似研究
environmental issues：环境问题
acquire：获得
ability：能力
appreciate：理解，赏析
value：重视
evaluate：评估
conflicting views：相互矛盾的观点		“One encouragement is that...” 表语从句；“suggest” 表明；“seem to acquire” 似乎获得；“the ability to do...” 不定式作定语；列举三个动词。
Environmental education offers an arena in which these skills can be developed, which is essential for these children as future decision-makers.环境教育提供了一个舞台，这些技能可以在其中得到发展，这对作为未来决策者的孩子们至关重要。environmental education：环境教育
offers：提供
arena：舞台，领域
skills：技能
developed：发展
essential：至关重要的
decision-makers：决策者		“offers an arena in which...” 定语从句；“which is essential...” 非限制性定语从句修饰整个主句或前文；“as future decision-makers” 作为未来决策者。
Some of the senses that we and other terrestrial mammals take for granted are either reduced or absent in cetaceans or fail to function well in water.我们和其他陆地哺乳动物视为理所当然的一些感官，在鲸目动物身上要么减弱或缺失，要么在水中无法正常工作。senses：感官
terrestrial mammals：陆地哺乳动物
take for granted：认为……理所当然
reduced：减弱
absent：缺失
cetaceans：鲸目动物
fail to function：无法工作		“take for granted” 固定搭配，认为……理所当然；“either reduced or absent... or fail...” 并列结构；“fail to function” 无法正常运作。
For example, it appears from their brain structure that toothed species are unable to smell.例如，从它们的大脑结构来看，齿鲸似乎没有嗅觉。appears：似乎
brain structure：大脑结构
toothed species：齿鲸类（有牙齿的物种）
unable to：不能
smell：嗅觉，闻		“it appears that...” 句型，意为“似乎……”；“from their brain structure” 根据大脑结构；“toothed species” 指有齿的鲸类。
Baleen species, on the other hand, appear to have some related brain structures but it is not known whether these are functional.另一方面，须鲸似乎有一些相关的大脑结构，但尚不清楚这些结构是否起作用。baleen species：须鲸类
on the other hand：另一方面
related：相关的
brain structures：大脑结构
functional：起作用的，功能性的		“on the other hand” 表示对比转折；“appear to have” 似乎有；“it is not known whether...” 主语从句，it 为形式主语。
It has been speculated that, as the blowholes evolved and migrated to the top of the head, the neural pathways serving sense of smell may have been nearly all sacrificed.据推测，随着喷气孔进化并迁移到头顶，负责嗅觉的神经通路可能几乎全部牺牲了。speculated：推测
blowholes：喷气孔
evolved：进化
migrated：迁移
neural pathways：神经通路
serving：服务于，负责
sense of smell：嗅觉
sacrificed：牺牲，丧失		“It has been speculated that...” 人们推测……；“as” 随着，引导时间状语从句；“serving sense of smell” 现在分词短语作定语；“may have been sacrificed” 可能已经被牺牲。
Similarly, although at least some cetaceans have taste buds, the nerves serving these have degenerated or are rudimentary.类似地，尽管至少有些鲸目动物有味蕾，但负责味蕾的神经已经退化或处于未发育状态。similarly：类似地
at least：至少
taste buds：味蕾
nerves：神经
serving：负责
degenerated：退化
rudimentary：未发育的，基本的		“although” 引导让步状语从句；“serving these” 修饰 nerves；“have degenerated or are rudimentary” 并列谓语。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 1 - 2026-08-06 02:38
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：38 分钟 (1899 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
The second question concerned the geographical location of rainforests. 第二个问题涉及热带雨林的地理位置。 geographical: 地理的
rainforest: 热带雨林
concerned: 涉及，与…有关		 concerned 在此为及物动词，意为“涉及”；geographical location 是名词短语作宾语。
The commonest responses were continents or countries: Africa (given by 43% of children), South America (30%), Brazil (25%). 最常见的回答是大陆或国家：非洲（43%的儿童提及）、南美洲（30%）、巴西（25%）。 commonest: 最常见的 (common的最高级)
continents: 大陆
responses: 回答		 commonest 是 common 的最高级形式；括号中的 given by... 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰前面的 Africa 等。
Some children also gave more general locations, such as being near the Equator. 一些孩子还给出了更笼统的位置，例如在赤道附近。 Equator: 赤道
general: 大致的，笼统的
being near: 位于…附近		 such as being near the Equator 中，such as 后接动名词短语表示举例；being near 相当于“在…附近”。
Responses to question three concerned the importance of rainforests. 对问题三的回答涉及热带雨林的重要性。 responses: 回答
importance: 重要性		 Responses to... 表示“针对…的回答”，concerned 再次作“涉及”解。
The dominant idea, raised by 64% of the pupils, was that rainforests provide animals with habitats. 由64%的小学生提出的主要观点是，热带雨林为动物提供了栖息地。 dominant: 主导的，主要的
raised: 提出
pupils: 学生
habitats: 栖息地
provide...with...: 为…提供…		 raised by... 是过去分词短语作定语；that 引导表语从句；固定搭配 provide sb. with sth.。
Fewer students responded that rainforests provide plant habitats, and even fewer (60%) raised the idea of rainforest as animal habitats. 较少的学生回答雨林提供植物栖息地，而更少（的学生）（60%）提出了雨林作为动物栖息地的观点。 fewer: 更少的
responded: 回答
raised the idea: 提出观点		 Fewer students... 是比较级；括号中的百分比对更少的学生作补充说明。
Similarly, but at a lower level, more girls (13%) than boys (5%) said that rainforests provided human habitats. 类似地，但比例更低，更多的女孩（13%）比男孩（5%）说雨林提供了人类栖息地。 similarly: 类似地
at a lower level: 在较低层次/比例上
provided: 提供		 Similarly, but at a lower level 作状语；more... than... 比较结构；said 后接宾语从句。
These observations are generally consistent with our previous studies of pupils' views about the use and conservation of rainforests, in which girls were shown to be more sympathetic to animals and expressed views which seem to place an intrinsic value on non-human animal life. 这些观察结果总体上与我们之前关于学生对雨林利用和保护看法的研究一致，在那些研究中，女孩被证明对动物更有同情心，并表达了似乎赋予非人类动物生命内在价值的观点。 observations: 观察(结果)
consistent with: 与…一致
previous: 之前的
conservation: 保护
sympathetic: 有同情心的
intrinsic: 内在的，固有的
place a value on: 赋予…价值
non-human: 非人类的		 are consistent with 为固定搭配；in which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代 studies；were shown to be 是被动语态；place an intrinsic value on... 是固定表达。
The fourth question concerned the causes of the destruction of rainforests. 第四个问题涉及雨林破坏的原因。 causes: 原因
destruction: 破坏		 the causes of the destruction of rainforests 是由 of 构成的所属结构。
Perhaps encouragingly, more than half of the pupils (59%) identified that it is human activities which are destroying rainforests, some personalizing the responsibility by the use of terms such as 'we are'. 也许令人鼓舞的是，超过一半的学生（59%）认识到是人类活动正在破坏热带雨林，一些人通过使用“我们是”这样的措辞将责任个人化。 encouragingly: 令人鼓舞地
identified: 识别出，发现
personalizing: 使个人化
responsibility: 责任
terms: 措辞		 Perhaps encouragingly 是句子副词；it is... which... 为强调句型；some personalizing... 是独立主格结构，作伴随状语。
About 18% of the pupils referred specifically to logging activity. 大约18%的学生特别提到了伐木活动。 referred to: 提到
specifically: 特别地，具体地
logging: 伐木		 referred to 是固定短语，注意 refer 的过去式 referred 要双写 r。
One misconception, expressed by some 1% of the pupils, was that acid rain is responsible for rainforest destruction. 一个误解，由大约1%的学生表达，是酸雨导致了雨林破坏。 misconception: 误解，错误观念
expressed: 表达
acid rain: 酸雨
responsible for: 对…负责，是…的原因		 expressed by... 是过去分词短语作定语；that 引导表语从句；is responsible for 表示“是…的原因”。
A similar proportion said that pollution is destroying rainforests. 类似比例（的学生）说污染正在破坏雨林。 proportion: 比例
pollution: 污染		 A similar proportion 作主语，指前文提到的百分比的学生。
Here, children are confusing rainforest destruction with damage to the forests of Western Europe by these factors. 这里，孩子们将雨林破坏与这些因素对西欧森林造成的破坏混淆了。 confusing: 混淆
damage: 损害, 破坏
Western Europe: 西欧
factors: 因素		 are confusing A with B 是 confuse... with... 的进行时，意为“把A与B混淆”；damage to the forests 是名词短语。
While two fifths of the students provided the information that the rainforests provide oxygen, in some cases this response also embraced the misconception that rainforest destruction would reduce atmospheric oxygen, making the atmosphere incompatible with human life on Earth. 虽然五分之二的学生提供了雨林提供氧气这一信息，但在某些情况下，这种回答也包含了误解，即雨林破坏会减少大气中的氧气，使大气变得不适合人类在地球上生存。 two fifths: 五分之二
embraced: 包含，接纳
reduce: 减少
atmospheric: 大气的
incompatible: 不相容的，不适合的		 While 引导让步状语从句；that the rainforests provide oxygen 为同位语从句；embraced the misconception that... 中 that 引导同位语从句；making the atmosphere... 是现在分词短语作结果状语，其中 incompatible with 是固定搭配。
